sophia.sales: Quick question  CloudVertex asked for a new co-brand badge variant for dark backgrounds. Can design produce one or do we need explicit permission?

jordan.design: We can make a dark-bg badge but partner doc says reversed mark requires written permission. If we mock one for preview we should label it draft.

carlos.cloudvertex: Request: please only show reversed badge as "preview" and state it is subject to our brand team's approval. We'll reply via email.

priya.legal: Note: add the partner trademark doc to the approval email and request sign-off within 72 hours. Also no customer logos on the one-pager without consent.

mike.marketing: Copy question: marketplace short blurb should mention "private deployments" and "dedicated capacity". Short version uploaded to drive.

elaine.partnerships: Timeline check  planning to send to partner Tue 10am PT to start approval window. Any blockers?

aisha.translations: If partner requests FR/DE, I need 48h lead. Flagging now.

jordan.design: I'll attach a draft reversed badge with the watermark "DRAFT - partner approval required" and export PNGs + PDF master.

legal-bot: reminder: create ticket `partner-asset-approval-2469998888` when assets are marked review-ready.

sophia.sales: Thanks all  action: Jordan produce draft assets, Priya prepare approval email, Mike finalize blurb, Elaine schedule send. I'll compile checklist after uploads.

mike.marketing: Uploaded final blurb to drive.

carlos.cloudvertex: We'll respond in the partner thread within 72 hours of send.

sophia.sales: Great, closing thread for now. Post updates in this thread when ready.
